description: Configuration for the Agent Action Guard, which ensures that only authorized actions are performed.

rules.description: Requires gathering exact live context before proceeding with an action.
Requires approval from a human before proceeding with an action.
Denies any action that is not explicitly allowed.
Grants pre-action clearance but does not bypass repository-native architecture, CI, review, security, privacy, licensing/provenance, Product Reality, or reserved-human gates.
